title: Jason Sands: they want their stuff back

tellings.quote: they want their stuff back and they're going to kill everybody involved in the program if they don't get it.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats a claim from a man named Jason Sands, in connection with the podcast host Joe Rogan, about whoever owns material held in a secret program. As Michels tells it, they want their stuff back and will kill everybody involved in the program if they don't get it, which, if true, would mean those keeping it are in danger.
